description: Distributed traces for the Redis Streams transport, from the Jaeger sidecar that `task dev:full:tracing` brings up. The Jaeger datasource only resolves while that profile is running; in the default metrics-only loop this dashboard shows no data (open the metrics dashboard 'Mercure Redis Transport' instead). The full trace explorer with the timeline/flamegraph view is the Jaeger UI at http://localhost:16686.

options.content: Traces are emitted by the hub only when tracing is enabled (`task dev:full:tracing`, which sets the Caddy `tracing` directive + points OTLP at the Jaeger sidecar). Spans: **`mercure.publish`**, **`mercure.subscribe`**, and the transport's **`mercure.transport.history`** (carrying `mercure.history.events_replayed` / `.future_dated` / `.full_scan` / `.truncated`). Click a row below to open the trace, or use the **Jaeger UI** link (top-right) for the full timeline/flamegraph and tag search.

panels.title: Recent mercure-hub traces
panels.description: Trace search against the Jaeger datasource (service = mercure-hub). Each row links to the full trace. No data unless `task dev:full:tracing` is running.
